## Interfaces

Shared `se_workflow.aa_resolve.resolve_aa_command()` (BIN → ROOT → CLAUDE/CURSOR plugin-root + sibling AA → PATH; no home quiet fallback) re-exported by `se_workflow.aa` and wrapped as `dashboard.artifact_store.aa_command()`; dashboard approval/backlog/dismiss/model call `aa_command()`. Close-batch logic lives in `se_workflow/close_batch.py`; `se_workflow.cli` / `bin/se-workflow close-batch` expose `--input`/`--out`/`--cwd` with exit 0/1/2. Skills: ensure-store plugin-root env-first then skill-relative; verify-work documents `se-workflow close-batch` (scripts/close_batch.py removed). Journal helpers use 40s `_until` timeouts.

## Assumptions

Hosts set CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT or skills run from a tree where skill-relative root works; AA discoverable via sibling plugin or PATH after install; env overrides remain for local checkouts; Landing merge/store commit is human-gated at phase close (out of tree).

## Invariants

close-batch only builds NDJSON for `adaptive-artifacts apply` (no store writes); tdd/check authority stays runner check-runs / request-carried ids (verify_authority + close_batch refusal paths intact); no adaptive-artifacts runtime edits in the phase diff; home checkout not in resolve order (tests assert PATH wins / FileNotFoundError when only home exists).

## Conflicts

none
